scene: A cyan figure gestures with an open palm toward a magenta figure whose chest shows a glowing battery level indicator, half full.
A cyan figure holds out a glowing yellow lightbulb on an open palm, offering it to a magenta figure. The magenta figure has a hand on its chin, and small turning gears glow inside its head.
A magenta figure stands at a fork where one path splits into two, shrugging with both palms up and head tilted. Both paths fade into glowing fog after a few steps.
A cyan figure strains to lift a heavy glowing box, knees bent, and reaches one hand out toward a magenta figure walking over to help.

Two figures with their BACKS to each other, walking apart toward opposite edges of the image (left figure walks left, right figure walks right), each turning the head back over the shoulder to wave goodbye. They are moving away from each other, not approaching. Between them floats a small glowing yellow clock with the hands moving forward.
At an open doorway, a cyan figure hands a small glowing yellow sun to a magenta figure who is leaving, like handing over a gift.
A figure shades its eyes with one hand, looking at a large chaotic swirl of glowing orbits and sparks.
A cyan figure points to its own ear with one hand and toward a magenta figure with the other. A glowing dotted signal arc travels from the magenta figure back to the cyan figure's ear.
A cyan figure raises one index finger in a 'wait' gesture toward a magenta figure who has stopped mid-step. A small glowing hourglass beside them has a single grain of sand falling.

A magenta figure is frozen between two glowing doors, one hand reaching toward each, unable to choose. A cyan figure stands nearby with arms crossed, tapping one foot impatiently. No cosmetics or makeup.

Two figures stand far apart on opposite sides of the image, separated by glowing wavy lines like an ocean. A single continuous luminous thread runs from one figure's hand to the other's, connecting them.

At a counter, a cyan figure leans slightly forward with a polite small bow, pointing at one glowing icon (a coffee cup) on a board of simple icons. A magenta figure behind the counter listens attentively.
Two figures walk side by side along a straight glowing road. One raises a finger mid-step as a small side path branches off the road toward a small glowing object.

meaning_pt: Não tenha pressa / Leve o tempo que precisar.
scene: A magenta figure sits relaxed holding a steaming cup. A cyan figure stands beside it with a calm downward palm gesture. A small glowing snail crawls slowly around the edge of a large clock.
A magenta figure looks apologetic next to a small spilled cup, with a little storm cloud above its head. A cyan figure waves a hand casually, and the storm cloud is dissolving into sparkles.

A figure with a hand on its chin walks around a circular glowing track worn by many laps of footprints. A spiral thought trail rises from its head and ends in a small lightbulb that is just starting to glow.
A cyan figure speaks, and a glowing puzzle piece floats from its mouth into a matching gap in the magenta figure's head, clicking into place with a burst of light. The magenta figure nods.
A magenta figure holds out a small glowing yellow plan sheet toward a cyan figure. The cyan figure nods and gives an enthusiastic thumbs-up.
A cyan figure bows slightly toward a magenta figure, pressing both hands over its chest in heartfelt gratitude. Between them floats a glowing yellow heart surrounded by gentle radiating pulse rings.

A cyan figure faces a magenta figure, nodding firmly while shaking the magenta figure's hand. Directly above their joined hands, two glowing yellow light beams cross and fuse into a single bright, unified star.

A magenta figure stands with hands clasped in relief. Facing it, a cyan figure casually balances a large glowing yellow boulder on a single outstretched fingertip, resting its other hand on its hip without any effort.
A magenta figure holds up a small glowing yellow lightbulb that has just switched on, with bright radiating rays. Facing it, the cyan figure leans in and claps its hands, impressed.

A cyan figure leans eagerly forward on tiptoes, clasping both hands near its chest in excited anticipation. Ahead on a straight glowing path, a glowing yellow gift box radiates joyful sparkles. Beside it, a magenta figure smiles and gestures forward toward the gift.

A cyan figure tilts its head, scratching the back of its head with one hand while holding out an open, questioning palm toward a magenta figure. Between them, a glowing yellow ribbon hangs twisted in a tangled, messy knot with dangling loose ends. The magenta figure gestures with open hands, trying to explain.

A cyan figure steps back with both open palms extended toward a magenta figure, stepping aside to yield control. The magenta figure stands in front, holding a glowing yellow steering wheel in both hands to choose the direction. No upward arrows, stairs, or climbing.

A cyan figure rushes forward with arms spread wide for a joyful reunion hug toward a magenta figure, who mirrors the open-armed greeting. Floating above them, a glowing yellow tear-off calendar sheds a cascade of blank pages drifting through the air. No text or numbers.

A cyan figure lightly rests one hand on the back of an empty glowing yellow chair next to a seated magenta figure, pausing before pulling it. The cyan figure tilts its head with a polite, inquiring open-palm gesture directed at the magenta figure. No brains or minds.

A cyan figure shrugs with raised shoulders, head tilted, and both empty hands held out with palms facing upward. Above its head floats a glowing green thought cloud that is completely empty inside. Facing it, a magenta figure extends one inquiring hand. No lightbulb.

A cyan figure lowers a glowing yellow smiling mask away from its face with one hand, speaking earnestly with an open palm toward a magenta figure. The magenta figure leans slightly forward, listening attentively. No theatrical stage, party costumes, or text.

A magenta figure stands with slumped shoulders and bowed head, holding a drooping glowing yellow flower. A cyan figure leans in empathetically, placing a comforting hand on the magenta figure's shoulder while pressing its other hand over its own chest. No oversized ears, hearing aids, or headphones.

A cyan figure leans forward toward a magenta figure, cupping one hand behind its ear while extending the other hand with an inquiring open palm. Between them floats a glowing yellow circular arrow forming a clean rewind loop. The magenta figure pauses mid-gesture, ready to speak again. No text, letters, or speech bubbles.

A magenta figure stands in startled surprise with hands raised beside its cheeks. Facing it, a cyan figure laughs heartily with one hand resting on its stomach and the other hand waving in a playful, reassuring gesture. No children, babies, or goats.

A cyan figure stands relaxed with hands in pockets beside a vertical column of three glowing green checkmarks, all lit. A magenta figure next to it lowers its shoulders and lets out a breath of relief.

A magenta figure sits curled on the floor, burying its face in both hands in deep distress. A cyan figure crouches beside it with concern, gently resting one hand on the magenta figure's back while extending an inquiring open palm. No atoms, molecules, or laboratory equipment.

meaning_pt: Sabe o que eu quero dizer?
scene: A cyan figure leans forward toward a magenta figure, tapping the side of its head with one index finger while gesturing with an inquiring open palm. The magenta figure nods in clear realization and points back in mutual understanding. Between their heads, a glowing yellow wavelength beam pulses smoothly, connecting them in sync.
